title: Rose Puzzle 20 Today I Beat My Dad at Pokemon
author: RailMan
rules:
This is the 20th puzzle designed by my 9yo daughter Rose. We hope you enjoy it. Kind words for a young setter are always appreciated. Regards, Rail Man

Irregular 6x6 sudoku rules apply. Place the digits 1 - 6 once in every row, column and bold outlined region.

Digits separated by a white dot are consecutive.

Digits separated by a black dot are in a 1:2 ratio.

Digits in the cage sum to the total shown in the top left corner.

Digits in the large circle must appear in a cell touching the circle.

Solve Online : Solution Check is enabled

If you enjoyed this puzzle then Rose has more puzzles that you might enjoy. Regards, Rail Man.
